scenario: `t in i` holds iff `i.start <= t < i.end` (LINT.3.1.1). `s.val in (s.lo..s.hi)` with lo=1, hi=10: val=5 is inside and val=10 is the excluded end, so `r` fires exactly once.
rules_ds:
schema Sample scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Int mutable
    lo: Int mutable
    hi: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sample s where s.val in (s.lo..s.hi)
->
    log info "in range"
